components.name: Outlined Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--outline, #747775); background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #0b57d0); font: 500 13px/20px system-ui, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; position: relative; isolation: isolate; } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; z-index: -1; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-btn:hover::after { background: var(--hover, rgb(31 31 31 / 0.08)); } .ds-btn:active::after { background: var(--pressed, rgb(31 31 31 / 0.12)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b57d0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Container Row
components.description: Extensions-menu-style row: tinted avatar, name with the coral this-tab dot, meta, and a shortcut hint that gives way to round actions on hover or focus.
components.html: CContoso 3 tabs · 2 sitesCtrl+Shift+1
components.css: .ds-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; width: 340px; font: 13px/20px system-ui, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--on-surface, #1f1f1f); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-item:hover { background: var(--hover, rgb(31 31 31 / 0.08)); } .ds-item:active { background: var(--pressed, rgb(31 31 31 / 0.12)); } .ds-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #1a73e8) 22%, var(--surface, #ffffff)); color: var(--blue, #1a73e8); flex: none; } .ds-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; } .ds-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--this-tab, #f26d6d); } .ds-meta { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #474747); } .ds-hint { font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #474747); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-item:hover .ds-hint, .ds-item:focus-within .ds-hint { display: none; } .ds-actions { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); display: flex; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 120ms; } .ds-item:hover .ds-actions, .ds-item:focus-within .ds-actions { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; } .ds-icon-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #474747); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, rgb(31 31 31 / 0.08)); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b57d0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15); overflow: hidden; font: 13px/20px system-ui, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--on-surface, #1f1f1f); max-width: 680px; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 56px; } .ds-card-row + .ds-card-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #e3e3e3); } .ds-grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-grow small { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #474747); } .ds-card kbd { font: inherit; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-high, #e9eef6); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; flex: none; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch span { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--outline, #747775); background: var(--surface-high, #e9eef6); transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; pointer-events: none; } .ds-switch span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 50%; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: -5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--outline, #747775); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), width 150ms, height 150ms, margin 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-switch input:checked + span { background: var(--primary, #0b57d0); border-color: var(--primary, #0b57d0); } .ds-switch input:checked + span::after { transform: translateX(15px); width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: -6px; left: 2px; background: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b57d0); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every surface the extension owns (the 340px toolbar popup, the full-page site prompt, the settings page) is built to read as a Chrome feature, not an extension's mini-app. The reference set is Chrome's own current Material UI: the profile menu, the extensions menu, the tab group editor and chrome://settings, in light and dark. Craft is measured by whether a person could tell the extension's popup apart from those menus; the goal is that they cannot.

The system is dense and quiet. Body text sits at Chrome's 13px, rows are menu-height, state is shown with 8% and 12% overlays of the text colour, and separation comes from 1px hairline dividers and tonal containers rather than decoration. Colour is functional: blue for focus and primary action, red for error, Chrome's nine tab-group colours for container identity. The rejected alternative is the bespoke card dashboard most container extensions ship.

There are exactly two brand marks inside these pages: the extension icon (in the settings top bar and on the prompt card) and the small coral dot that marks the container the current tab is in. Everything else is borrowed from the platform.
keyCharacteristics: Chrome Material tokens, light and dark, switched by `prefers-color-scheme` only.
System UI font at Chrome's sizes; a 13px/20px body and nothing larger than 20px.
Full-width menu rows with full-row hover bands; pill buttons and a pill search.
Container identity carried by emoji-or-initial avatars on tab-group colours.
One coral dot (#f26d6d) as the only extension-owned accent.

rules.name: The Two Marks Rule
rules.body: The only brand elements inside the pages are the extension icon and the coral this-tab dot. No other colour, gradient or ornament from the icon family enters the UI.

rules.name: The Blue Means Act Rule
rules.body: Primary blue appears only where the user can act or is focused: buttons, focus rings, checked controls, insertion lines. It is never a heading colour or a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Identity Palette Rule
rules.body: Tab-group colours identify containers and nothing else. They are not status colours and never tint chrome.

rules.name: The Chrome Sizes Rule
rules.body: Type stays on Chrome's ramp: 11, 12, 13, 15, 20px. Nothing larger, no display face, no uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Popup Is Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing inside the popup casts a shadow; Chrome draws the bubble, the extension draws tone and hairlines.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the token set and switch light and dark with `prefers-color-scheme` alone.
**Do** show hover and press as the 8% and 12% ink overlays, across the full width of a row.
**Do** keep type on Chrome's ramp (11, 12, 13, 15, 20px) in the system UI font, with weight as the only emphasis.
**Do** use the 2px blue focus ring (offset 2px, inset -2px on full-width rows and the search pill) on every focusable control.
**Do** draw icons as inline 1.75-stroke line SVGs in the current text colour.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by collapsing transitions and animations to 0ms.
donts: **Don't** add brand colour, gradients or ornaments from the icon family to the pages; the icon and the coral dot are the only marks.
**Don't** use primary blue as decoration, or the tab-group colours for anything but container identity.
**Don't** put shadows inside the popup; the Card Lift shadow belongs to settings and prompt cards only.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface, uppercase labels, or type larger than 20px.
**Don't** build bespoke cards or dashboard tiles for the container list; it is a menu of rows.
